origin: Researcher-designed, 2026-09-23, direct descendant of wm_fix_reversal v2's mechanism, narrowed to a more specific institutional-flow hypothesis (month-end hedge rebalancing) per research on FX month-end flows.
thesis: Large asset managers, pension funds, and corporates rebalance currency hedges at month-end based on that month's realized equity performance, with flow concentrating in the final 2-3 trading days and peaking on the last day, specifically around the London 4pm fix. Hypothesis: fix-window spikes on these specific days are more often genuine flow-driven (and thus more reliably reversion-prone) than an average day's spike.

entry.calendar_filter: only trade if today is within TradeLastNDaysOfMonth (3 default) calendar days of month-end
entry.measurement_window: 17:55-18:02 server time (15:55-16:02 London), identical to wm_fix_reversal
entry.trigger: fix-window move >= max(MinSpikeSizePipsFloor, MinSpikeVsAvgMultiplier * rolling average of the fix window's own recent history, fed every day regardless of the calendar filter)
entry.side: fade -- sell if price rose into the fix, buy if it fell

exit.rule: market close 30 minutes after the measurement window closes if SL/TP not hit, or end-of-day flat at 22:00 server

tunable_parameters_to_sweep: TradeLastNDaysOfMonth (3 default -- how many days before month-end the flow concentration research describes), MinSpikeVsAvgMultiplier -- not yet swept.

demo_criteria.rationale: Low frequency by design (only ~3 trading days/month qualify at all, further filtered by the spike threshold) -- similar low-frequency profile to gotobi, anchor adjusted accordingly rather than the standard day_trading category anchor.
